module.purpose: Provides hover-preview behavior for canvas comment markers, including delayed visibility, thread selection, card rendering, overflow indication, and stable thread ordering.
module.summary: This module implements the canvas comment preview layer. It derives readable opening comments from live comment data, caps displayed threads, reports hidden-thread overflow, and renders previews using the same card and positioning concepts as full comment panels. A shared editor atom ensures only one marker preview is active, while delayed timers allow pointer movement between markers and the floating panel without flicker. Preview cards can optionally open their associated thread.
module.businessContext: Supports collaborative canvas commenting by making nearby discussion threads discoverable without opening a full panel. Failure would hide comment context or make marker-to-thread navigation unreliable.
